title: UI Surface Map
description: Machine-readable surface discovery output for the UI skill (Stage 1). Conforms to the surface evidence model in core/surface-discovery.md.

slug.description: Machine slug used as the .ui/<slug>/ directory name.

routes.description: Routes that lead to the surface (URL paths or route names).

styles.description: CSS / SCSS / CSS Modules / Tailwind config entrypoints relevant to the surface.

scripts.description: JS / TS interaction files wired to the surface.

components.description: Component names / paths in framework stacks.

states.description: States the surface can be in (default, loading, error, empty, success, ...).

viewports.description: Viewport widths (CSS px) to audit. Minimum three (smallest, mid, largest target) unless single-viewport surface.

tokens_referenced.description: Design tokens (CSS custom properties / theme keys / Sass vars) referenced by the surface.

accessibility_landmarks.description: Landmark elements on the surface (header, nav, main, aside, footer).

evidence_availability.description: Highest evidence tier achievable for the surface. Caps allowed confidence (see core/evidence-model.md).

stack.description: Detected stack (react, vue, jinja, django, flask, fastapi, tailwind, bootstrap, vanilla css, scss, css modules, css-in-js, unknown).

discovery_notes.description: Free-text notes about discovery gaps, mis-named prompts, sampling decisions.
